titles: reads the version 3 fields at their fsb_read_header offsets with bounded reads inside the 88-byte header
seeks backwards into the header for a data offset below 88, as avio_skip does
flags a short final packet with copyRefusal and keeps whole-packet inputs copyable
refuses versions, formats, rates, channels, truncation, offsets and partial samples with native statuses where native fails
checks the abort signal around every header read and packet read
probes the eight bytes fsb_probe reads and registers a demux-only descriptor
demuxes through the PCM backend and refuses copy of short tails, fsb output, seeks and bad inputs before any output opens
matches native FSB3 copy and decode framecrc, wav and raw outputs for 1/2/4 channels, three rates, data offsets and short tails
matches native FSB3 output -ss, -t and -frames selections for copy and decode
mirrors native FSB version, format, rate and channel statuses and refuses FSB4, ADPCM, partial samples, truncation and input seeks before any output

nativeComparisons.statusDetail: 176 (PATCHWELCOME) for FSB1, FSB5, a non-digit version under -f fsb and two unknown FSB3 formats; 183 (INVALIDDATA) for rate 0, negative rate, zero channels and a 60-byte header; each under decode and copy

unsupported: FSB3 adpcm_ima_wav / adpcm_psx / adpcm_thp formats: native decodes or copies, refused
partial trailing sample frame: native emits a partial final packet, refused
-c copy of a payload that is not whole 4096*channels-byte packets: native flags the final packet F=0x3, refused via copyRefusal (decode supported)
more than 512 channels: native decode fails with EINVAL but copy works, refused
data offset beyond EOF: native yields an empty stream, refused
87-byte header with a non-zero low channel byte: native opens it, refused as truncated
undeclared .fsb inputs that fail fsb_probe: no extension fallback (native extension score is 1 next to read_probe)

proposedContracts.name: matches native FSB3 copy and decode framecrc, wav and raw outputs for 1/2/4 channels, three rates, data offsets and short tails
proposedContracts.scope: FSB3 pcm_s16le, 1/2/4 channels, 22050/24000/44100 Hz, whole packets, short tails (copy refused, decode compared), data at 88 and backward offset 0x40; framecrc copy (with/without -f fsb) and decode, wav, raw copy and decode

proposedContracts.name: matches native FSB3 output -ss, -t and -frames selections for copy and decode
proposedContracts.scope: output -ss, -t, -ss+-t, -frames:a and -ss past end; copy and decode on whole packets, decode on short tails

proposedContracts.name: mirrors native FSB version, format, rate and channel statuses and refuses FSB4, ADPCM, partial samples, truncation and input seeks before any output
proposedContracts.scope: native 176/183 statuses mirrored for versions, formats, rate, channels and truncation; explicit refusals of FSB4, ADPCM flags, partial samples, >512 channels, offset past EOF, 87-byte header and input seeks

notes: Node 24.22.3 from /opt/node24 was used; the bootstrap (npm, submodule, reference) took 260 s (npm 10.9 s, submodule 9.8 s, reference build about 239 s).
Baseline before registering the module: typecheck, lint, boundaries and the three container registry tests (17) passed in 83 s.
PATCHWELCOME (176) and INVALIDDATA (183) are FFERRTAG statuses, not errno values, so they are host-independent; no errno-dependent status is mirrored.
Native fsb_read_header refuses FSB4 formats outside XMA2/THP with 176 too; the port refuses every FSB4 input with exit 1 because it does not parse the FSB4 header.
All cases are integer/copy; no linux-gated tests.
